messages:
priya: Starting bring-up of lumen-7b-v2 (LLM derivative) quant int8 on dev-stg. Quick checklist and owners? I ran a small smoke and saw truncation on long prompts.
ben: thanks — can you paste the smoke prompts + any diffs? Also tag infra if perf numbers look off.
priya: paste prompts:
```
Q1: Summarize the article below in 2 sentences.
Q2: Extract the person's email from this text: "Contact: sam@company.com".
Q3(long): Write a short story about a cat who learns to code, 600 tokens.
```
priya: results: Q1 OK, Q2 sometimes returns 'Contact:' included, Q3 truncated after ~120 tokens. Tokenizer seems to be using bpe-variant mismatch.
anya: probable vocab mismatch — which tokenizer model file did you use?
priya: using tokenizer v2 from model package we uploaded (tokenizer.json). I'll re-run with tokenizer v1 to compare.
ben: also run the following quick checks:
- greedy vs sampling check
- prompt token count vs model accepted seq_len
- KV cache sanity: repeated prefix should be cached
miguel: infra-bot says GPU mem looks fine but out-of-order shapes warning in logs.
infra-bot: deploy: lumen-7b-v2/int8 -> dev-stg/slot-4
infra-bot: logs snippet:
```
WARNING: kernel_dispatch: expected dims [1, 1024], got [1, 512]
```
priya: that matches observed truncation. filing follow-up with infra.
ben: for quality/regressions run eval-bot on small benchmark set: halo-qa (50), extraction (30), summarization (20)
eval-bot: queued lumen-7b-v2-int8 -> eval-run 20240308-09
anya: also tag ops for seq_len config; might be default 512 in compile stage.
priya: timeline: re-run with tokenizer v1 + force seq_len=1024, then re-check caching. target EOD smoke results.
ben: if that fixes, we'll run quant tuning (per-layer 8-bit fallback) and compare latency/cost.
priya: thanks. assigning owners: infra: miguel, tokenizer/ops: anya, evals: ben. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
